items.t: AeroVironment Secures $405 Million International Order for LOCUST X3 Laser Defense Systems
items.sum: AeroVironment, Inc. (NASDAQ:AVAV) has received a $405 million international direct commercial sales order for its LOCUST X3 high-energy laser weapon systems, which will be used to expand counter-unmanned aircraft system capabilities in the Middle East.
